agent-secrets secret: --profile is not a flag: agent-secrets reads the store credential from the environment, as the cloud's own tools do. On Google Cloud set CLOUDSDK_ACTIVE_CONFIG_NAME (a gcloud configuration) or CLOUDSDK_CORE_ACCOUNT (a gcloud account), which CLOUDSDK_AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN and GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS outrank when set; on AWS set AWS_PROFILE, which access keys in AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE, outrank when set, as in the AWS CLI.
